title: very happy with this app!
body: ..i would really appreciate it if we could reset the day at a custom time and not on midnight though!
author: fafout

title: Simple yet full inclusive
body: Way of Life is the app that changed my life. It allows simple tracking of any habit, either a good one or avoiding a bad one, and also allows the addition of extra data through notes. The chart system is also incredible.
author: SiGm4

title: Pretty nice
body: Very helpful and well designed app...
author: Petros Simos

title: "Free" version is quit limited
body:
Having a limit of just 3 habits to track is way too low, especially when the "free" app has always-visible ads in every screen (among other restrictions)

The cost for the premium upgrade is high too.

Apart from these, the app is well designed and quite nice.
author: LykP
